snippet.title: Oxide: Survival Island || Open World PvP Survival on Mobile
snippet.description:
Welcome to the island where only the strongest survive.

Oxide: Survival Island is a hardcore open-world PvP survival game where every day is a fight for resources, territory, and your life.
Gather materials, build your base, form clans, craft weapons, and defend your territory from raids - or become the one who strikes first.

🔥 Massive open world
🔫 Intense PvP combat
🏗 Base building and raiding
🤝 Clans and team-based gameplay
⚙ Regular updates and live events

Do you have what it takes to survive?

https://oxi.de/play
Download Oxide: Survival Island and prove the island belongs to you.
